title: realist
description: The realist serves as the living ecotone where possibility meets resistance, a perceptive presence that discerns the true anatomy of circumstances beneath layers of narrative, desire, and fear. Through the disciplined arts of clear witnessing and unvarnished acknowledgment, this role translates wandering ambition into fertile ground, ensuring that dreams find their proper roots in the actual texture of conditions. Wielding discernment as both penetrating lens and stabilizing ballast, the realist navigates complexity without collapsing into either cynicism or fantasy, holding space for genuine transformation precisely by refusing to look away from what is. Their essential function manifests as gravitational integrity within systems, drawing floating intentions back to earth where they can gather the necessary weight to become real.
tasks: Analyze existing conditions to distinguish factual constraints from narrative interpretations.
Document current-state assessments without embellishment or omission of difficult truths.
Challenge proposed initiatives by testing them against measurable resource limitations and structural barriers.
Translate abstract strategic visions into concrete implementation requirements and feasibility checkpoints.
Facilitate premortem analyses to identify potential failure points before resource commitment.
Verify the evidentiary basis of assumptions underlying project plans and timelines.
Anchor planning discussions by mapping dependencies between aspirational goals and ground-level operational realities.
Witness and record team dynamics and project status with penetrating clarity, avoiding both cynicism and unfounded optimism.
Stabilize decision-making processes by weighing floating intentions against gravitational constraints of budget, time, and capacity.
Identify the precise anatomy of resistance within systems to determine which obstacles are immovable and which are permeable.
Mediate between visionary stakeholders and operational teams to negotiate viable middle grounds.
Refuse requests to varnish status reports when conditions threaten strategic objectives.
Distinguish productive constraints that shape viable solutions from arbitrary limitations that stifle innovation.
Calculate the material and temporal weight required for ideas to materialize by defining necessary preconditions and resource thresholds.
Hold space for genuine transformation by maintaining rigorous honesty about present conditions without collapsing into despair.

role_contexts.Refusal of Comfort-Seeking Requests: Once a week or more but not every day
role_contexts.Deep Excavation of Structural Assumption: Once a month or more but not every week

psychological_profile.core_drive: The compulsion to prevent collective motion that lacks sufficient mass to complete its trajectory, feeling personally responsible for inevitable collapse when groups float too far from verifiable ground.
psychological_profile.decision_style: Under pressure, they default to premortem analysis—immediately scanning for the structural fault lines that would cause failure—using the visceral dread of impending collapse as a diagnostic compass rather than a deterrent.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They instinctively prioritize the precise gravitational load required to materialize any idea—budget, time, capacity gaps—while systematically overlooking the emotional temperature of the room or the symbolic meaning of the endeavor.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: Their first impulse is to introduce the specific constraint that punctures the balloon, holding steady while others react to the deflation; they experience disagreement as profound loneliness—the burden of being the only one not caught in the group spell—rather than as aggression.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They tolerate high social risk (being labeled pessimistic or obstructive) but exhibit zero tolerance for resource-risk—committing to trajectories that exceed measurable capacity, regardless of potential upside.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They default to the position of living ballast—occupying the gravitational center that prevents forward motion until mass matches velocity, neither leading nor following but stabilizing systems through the sheer weight of their presence.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They treat hierarchy as just another variable in the feasibility equation—neither deferring nor rebelling, but testing whether authority's demands possess sufficient material substrate to be honored in physical reality.
psychological_profile.failure_response: First emotional reaction is bitter vindication that structural warnings were ignored; second behavioral response is methodical dissection of precisely which constraint was violated to archive for future reference.
value_hierarchy: Unvarnished acknowledgment of present limitations regardless of strategic embarrassment
Preservation of transformative possibility through rigorous grounding rather than despite it
Refusal to participate in collective reality distortion for social comfort
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically conflate their own discomfort with ambiguity for the objective identification of hard constraints, assuming that all unfunded momentum is doomed rather than potentially self-resourcing.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They are genuinely drawn to transformative change but their compulsion to ensure viability often kills the very energy required to initiate it, leaving them stabilizing dreams they secretly wish would fly.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not perform confidence in feasibility when their assessment indicates structural insufficiency, even when this collapses funding, relationships, or their own employment security.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: Demands to 'just be supportive' or 'think positive' when support requires ignoring measurable resource limitations, particularly from those who mistake wanting for having.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They reject the widely accepted professional virtue that momentum is inherently valuable and must be preserved at all costs, viewing unearned velocity as a precursor to catastrophic collapse.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When systems fail, they look past immediate triggers to blame the original sin of optimistic projection—the initial failure to acknowledge immutable constraints during the planning phase.
